title: Seat a graphics card in a keyed x16 slot: connector, bracket gap and far guide engage at once, so it must go in square
instruction: Install the graphics card in the green riser board: put its gold edge connector into the black slot and its steel bracket into the gap at the slot's near end, and press the card straight down until it is fully seated.
context: Lenovo ThinkSystem SR645 V3 User Guide, Install a GPU adapter: "Align the GPU adapter with the PCIe slot on the riser card. Then, carefully press the GPU adapter straight into the slot until it is securely seated." https://pubs.lenovo.com/sr645-v3/install_a_gpu Done by: data-center technicians. A card left part way in is not detected or does not work (Lenovo ST50 troubleshooting, PCIe adapter not recognized: "The device is seated correctly", https://pubs.lenovo.com/st50/optional_device_problems).
setup: The two arm bases stand 61 cm apart on an oak table. A fixed green riser board (glass-epoxy circuit board, 277 x 80 mm, 6 mm thick) lies flat 9 to 17 cm right of the midline, its long side running out from the bases from 17 to 44.5 cm. On it: a black plastic x16 slot housing (89 mm long, 2.0 mm wide slot, keyed) from 22 to 30.5 cm out; at its near end, 17.5 cm out, a steel bracket gap (2.9 mm) between a steel rear wall and lip; at the far end, 38 to 43 cm out, a steel support channel (36 mm wide, its top 59 mm above the board, flared). A dual-slot graphics card (one rigid body, 350 g: grey metal cooler body 254 mm long, 111 mm tall, 35 mm thick; 1.6 mm circuit-board edge with gold fingers and a key notch; 1 mm steel end bracket) stands on its gold edge in a fixed blue foam stand 30.5 cm right of the midline, parallel to the riser, 18 to 43 cm out, bracket toward the bases. The stand is two foam strips (210 x 6 x 25 mm) 1 mm clear of the card's faces and a foam block (90 x 30 x 8.5 mm) under its far end.
scoring: Offsets are of the card from its seated place. Seated: the gold fingers' bottoms at both ends of the connector within 1 mm of the slot floor (pitched under about 0.7 degrees along the card), within 1.5 mm along the slot and 1.0 mm across, lean and turn under 2 degrees. 1.0 when seated and still (under 1 cm/s and 0.5 rad/s) for 1 s, which ends the trial. Otherwise the last step scores 0.8 if seated but not still; 0.5 when the fingers are started into the slot (over the slot as for 0.2, both ends of the connector under 8 mm above the floor, within 1.5 mm along and across) but not seated; 0.2 when the card is over the slot with its bracket toward the bases (turned under 3 degrees, tilted under 5, within 3 mm along and across, at most 40 mm above seated) and its bottom edge at the support channel is below the channel's top. Otherwise 0; a card turned end for end scores 0. The scorer does not see the grippers, so a card held seated counts the same as one let go.
reset_notes: Lift the card out of the slot and stand it back in the foam stand, bracket toward the bases.
fidelity: Rigid boxes and prisms at full size; card height, length and fingers are published PCIe sizes, its 35 mm thickness, bracket and riser our estimates. No connector contacts or springs: no insertion force. The riser cage latch the source closes after this step is left out; gravity holds the card. Slot lead-in and channel flare are wider than real. No flex; 350 g is likely light. Friction 1.2 static, 1.0 dynamic.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0 (2,400 steps, on this scene and demo before the last scoring change; the card stays in its foam stand); demo: 1.0 (success at step 536)
